stemMd: A geologist writes: A thicker sediment layer does not always represent a longer interval. Deposition can accelerate after a flood, so a thick layer may accumulate quickly. Which assumption does the passage challenge?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Sediment accumulates at a constant rate in all circumstances.

options.label: B
options.textMd: All thick layers are deposited instantaneously.

explanationMd: Thickness measures accumulated material, not time directly. Inferring duration requires information about deposition rate, which can change after events such as floods.

distractorRationale.d: The author does not dispute this.
distractorRationale.e: The passage relies on that fact.
distractorRationale.b: The passage says some may form quickly, not instantaneously.
